description: List rentable assets, optionally filtered by category and/or availability.

category.description: Optional category filter (car, bike, scooter, tool, camera).

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of asset objects.

description: Retrieve a full asset object by aid.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the full asset object.

description: Add a new rentable asset to the catalog.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the new asset object.

description: List bookings, optionally filtered by status and/or renter. Sorted by start_date desc.

status.description: Optional status filter (reserved, active, returned, cancelled).

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of booking summaries.

description: Retrieve a full booking object by bid.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the full booking object.

description: Reserve an asset for a date range. Fails if the range conflicts with another active/reserved booking.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the new booking summary.

description: Cancel a booking that has not been returned or already cancelled.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the cancelled booking summary.

description: Mark a reserved/active booking as returned and free the asset.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the updated booking summary.

description: File a damage record against an asset (optionally tied to a booking) with a repair cost estimate.

bid.description: Booking identifier the damage occurred during (may be empty).

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the new damage record.

description: List damage records, optionally filtered by asset_id. Sorted by date desc.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of damage records.

description: Check whether an asset is available for a given date range against existing bookings.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is {aid, start_date, end_date, available}.

description: Sum revenue for an asset across active + returned bookings.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is {aid, bookings_counted, revenue}.

description: Search assets by keyword across name, category, and location.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of matching asset objects.

description: Aggregate stats: assets by category, bookings by status, damage count, active/returned revenue.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is {assets, by_category, bookings, by_status, damages, revenue}.
